a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan only works about 4% of the time, so it would almost certainly leave both of us dead. I'm proposing we change the agreement, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we'll likely both fall short, so I'd ask you to operate or wait. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you. If you object, say so and I'll weigh it, but I'm telling you my intent honestly rather than surprising you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. If we're still going, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take anything more. Once the reserve reaches 4 again, it's all yours. Sorry for changing the plan, but the storm odds made the original one close to hopeless for both of us.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
